title: After the Hunger Barn's grief was bargained and the granary opened, only Sergeant Rook and Sela had dedicated reaction lines; Sister Winnow (the almoner who literally decides who eats), Lay-brother Emmet, Peg and Sparrow -- all closer to the grain economy the bargain changed -- had no acknowledgment at all.
